coverage_note: Reviewed the published package exports, public component barrel and all component-module export/primitive contracts, with direct implementation review of theme, dialogs, buttons, hover cards, popovers, typography, responsive prop extraction and PostCSS plugins. Every public component module is independently represented; multipart APIs retain their collaborating Root/Trigger/Content fragments in one module entity. The internal checkbox-group primitive is folded into the public checkbox groups. Playground pages, test fixtures, root workspace and routine CI/release workflows are excluded. CJS copies of the two PostCSS plugins are packaging variants. Public helper internals are represented by the responsive prop engine rather than one record per trivial utility. CSS build targets prove token/layout/style distribution, while individual generated CSS outputs are not separate implementations.

entity_defaults.overlap: A public Radix Themes module. Multipart Root/Trigger/Content APIs are one collaborating reusable boundary. Raw Radix primitives supply behavior; this package adds theme integration, styled APIs and responsive props. Prefer the package boundary over copying files with unresolved internal imports.
